_comment: VALID on purpose, and specific to this package: the 0.4.0 change to the recommended profile. A feed with textLanguage and no organizers used to draw a warning on sight; now it draws one only when an event could actually inherit that language. Here every event declares its own, so the feed-level value labels nothing but the feed's own title and description — the warning must stay silent. Its sibling fixture, feed-textlanguage-event-inherits.json, is the same feed with one event that omits it.
